comment: Single source of truth for ACCEPTED / known divergences from real PlantUML jar SVG output, for the svg-conformance golden suite (T6). Mirrors dot-engine's test/corpus/accepted-divergences.json schema (see that project's PARITY.md for the dashboard/rules-gate consumption pattern this is designed to slot into). An accepted entry is a deliberate, maintainer-signed, won't-fix difference; everything non-conformant NOT listed here is an unaccepted gap the emitter is expected to close. match: {id} exact | {idPattern} glob. scope: describes which gate the entry applies to. `retired` holds entries that were accepted and later withdrawn, kept so the reversal is auditable rather than silent; a retired entry is NOT in force. `surveyBlind` (optional string) marks an entry whose divergence the survey comparator deliberately cannot see; it must name the exemption. The ledger gate fails on any in-force entry the survey records as conformant unless it carries `surveyBlind`.

entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (embedded {{ }} payload bytes -- declared divergence, DIVERGENCES.md, D9)
entries.reason: Embedded `{{ ... }}` sub-diagram payload bytes: the jar rasterises the nested diagram and emits `<image xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,...">` (`EmbeddedDiagram.java:165-195`); this port renders the nested source recursively with its own `renderSync` and emits the SVG source as `data:image/svg+xml;base64` (DIVERGENCES.md, `Embedded {{ }} sub-diagrams -- SVG source, not a re-encoded raster (deliberate, CDD T27)`; plans/class-divergence-drive/decisions.md D9). The `<image>` element, its position and its width/height are the target and are compared; only the href payload is declared. compare.ts already ignores data: hrefs, so this entry documents the declaration rather than excusing a verdict. Re-verified 2026-09-27 against 1.2026.8beta1 (cdd5 T0f): render-diff structural=0 numeric=0, identical to the 7beta11 measurement; oracle bytes unchanged by the re-pin. Re-verified 2026-10-09 (instrument-space-width, oracle seam #4: U+0020 = 44 tenths, widths float-rounded; whole oracle re-captured) with render-diff: pass=true structural=0 numeric=0. Numbers above this line were measured with the zero-width-space instrument (or, for embedded-diagram rows, before lgm's seam #3) and are superseded by this line.

entries.scope: svg-conformance unknown ledger (nested {{yaml}} image size -- Smetana path, cdd7 D8)
entries.reason: The description leaf embeds a `{{yaml ...}}` sub-diagram. cdd6 T2b made the outer canvas exact (0/5 -> 0/3, `svg/@width` 211 = jar) and cdd6 T3b/T5e closed the ink family; the residual is the embedded `<image>` width/height, off by 1 px, which is the nested yaml diagram's OWN size. `@startyaml` is a JsonDiagram laid out by Smetana in the jar and by @knowvah/dot-engine here (CLAUDE.md, one layout engine, ruling 2026-08-09; DIVERGENCES.md `Smetana-backed diagram types`), so the delta is the accepted Smetana geometry delta of the nested diagram, surfaced through the embed slot -- not a class or description defect. Signed by the maintainer's approval of plans/class-divergence-drive-7/decisions.md#D8 (2026-09-30). entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (nested {{yaml}} image size -- Smetana path, cdd7 D8 precedent; cogr D4)
entries.acceptedBy: maintainer (standing ruling 2026-08-09, DIVERGENCES.md `Smetana-backed diagram types`; pre-ruled for this row class by plans/class-oracle-gap-rows/decisions.md#D4)
entries.reason: A `node n [ {{yaml ...}} ]` leaf embeds a `@startyaml` sub-diagram with a nested `color:` list. `@startyaml` is a JsonDiagram laid out by Smetana in the jar (`SmetanaForJson.java:137-143`) and by @knowvah/dot-engine here (CLAUDE.md, one layout engine, ruling 2026-08-09). cogr T4e made every text, rect and textLength inside the embed equal to the jar (inline creole in a yaml cell, `TextBlockJson.java:345-347`); what remains is the nested diagram's own size: the child `Red`/`Green` table sits at x 128.237 against the jar's 128 and its edge at M79.237 against M78.5 (the U-REC/U-CLIP sources of the DIVERGENCES.md entry), so the embedded `<image>` is 184 wide against 183. Every other diff follows from that 1 px: render-diff 2026-11-14 pass=false structural=0 numeric=11 (`svg/@width` 244/243, the node polygon and its three lines +1, `image/@width` 184/183). Same mechanism and magnitude as svg-unknown/gubeca-19-lemu434 and jixibu-01-xave465 (cdd7 D8). The embed has an edge, so planning's 'single node, no residue' expectation did not hold; D4 adds such a row to the existing Smetana entry rather than opening a new divergence. A yaml-engine fix that makes the row conformant retires this entry via the ledger gate.

retired.scope: svg-conformance class golden ratchet (edge spline control points)
retired.reason: ORIGINAL (2026-08-08): The jar's edge-spline control points are quantized to 2 decimals; ours carry full precision, and clipping amplifies the difference into ~0.0097 at the trimmed end -- just over the harness's 0.01 tolerance. The quantization is Smetana's, not ours: on the jar's own svek-1.dot our engine returns exactly what real graphviz 15.1.1 returns. Smetana is a transpile of graphviz 2.38 and is years out of date; the maintainer's decision is that this port does NOT chase compatibility with it, so the cause is moot and our value is the better one.
retired.retiredReason: Withdrawn on two independent grounds, both measured. (1) THE PREMISE WAS FALSE. ~0.0097 is INSIDE the 0.01 band, not over it. Two artifacts stacked to make it fail anyway: 3-decimal SVG emission rounds 75.1940275463084 and 75.1843 apart to exactly 0.010, and the comparator's `Math.abs(a-b) > tolerance` then rejected that because IEEE-754 yields 0.010000000000005116 for the subtraction. The second is a harness defect, fixed in compare.ts#exceedsTolerance; the fixture now measures 0 diffs and is re-pinned. It was never outside the declared conformance band. (2) THE STATED CAUSE WAS WRONG. The quantization is not Smetana's. This fixture never touches Smetana -- it has a svek-1.dot, and Smetana paths emit none. svek/DotStringFactory.java:316 calls create(skinParam, dotString, "svg"), and GraphvizRuntimeEnvironment#create dispatches to GraphvizLinux, the external dot binary; PlantUML then scrapes that SVG TEXT. `dot -Tsvg` prints coordinates with 2 decimals, and real graphviz 15.1.1 on this fixture's own svek-1.dot emits M24.58,-107.74C24.58,-90.06 24.58,-65.87 24.58,-48.21 -- reproducing every jar value including the 24.58 the original diagnosis could not place. dot-engine's full-precision points rounded to 2dp are bit-identical to that output at all four control points, so the two engines AGREE and the difference is purely serialization precision. It therefore will NOT disappear when the jar updates graphviz. The 'we don't chase a 2.38 transpile' rationale does not apply to this fixture at all.
